items.html: *Behold, it was explained by us in the discourses of the Nukva of ZA, and in the matter of the diminution of the moon, that in all the time of the exile, ZON stand back to back all the days of the week, except in the hours of prayer and on the Sabbaths and the like, as explained there. And when they want to return face to face, the aspect of the falling of the dormita upon ZA must precede, so that the sawing (Nisira) may be performed and she may be able to return with him face to face, as mentioned in the discourses of Rosh Hashanah.
